description: TRACK_STATUS_OK as a publisher sends it in answer to TRACK_STATUS (draft-ietf-moq-transport-22 §9.13): a REQUEST_OK (§9.3), whose Type is the varint 0x07, then a 16-bit Length, then the body. The body is Number of Parameters, LARGEST_OBJECT (type 0x09, §9.20.17, a Location: Group then Object, two varints) when the publisher has published an object, then the Track Properties (§8.4: delta-encoded types in ascending order, an even type carrying a varint and an odd one a length-prefixed byte value), which run to the end of the message and add no bytes when empty. The bytes are the same on moqt-22 and moqt-20: the drafts differ only in LOCATION_FILTER, which this message does not carry.
sources: derived from the encoding rules of draft-ietf-moq-transport-22 §9.3, §9.20.17, §8.4 and the §8.1 varint, by hand; the draft text has no TRACK_STATUS_OK example
